credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} and operating profit by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, so the margin held broadly flat at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}.
Gross leverage fell by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, and net cash rose by {{net_cash.change@FY2025}} to {{net_cash@FY2025}}.

Cash generation strengthened: FFO to debt rose by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} and FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, with free cash flow of {{fcf@FY2025}}.
Interest coverage weakened by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, as airline net financing charges rose on lower interest income and higher charges on borrowings.
Capex intensity was stable at {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median.

liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2025}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities after the new revolving credit facility replaced the prior UK Export Finance and smaller facilities.

Cash and cash-like investments were stable at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, so cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} as revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2025}}.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, so a larger share of liquidity is customers' prepayments.
The group repaid a Eurobond at maturity during the year and refreshed its EMTN programme to broaden its funding options.

peer_positioning.text: easyJet has the lowest net leverage of the low-cost peers ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}), at {{net_leverage@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@2025}}, and also ranks highest on gross leverage ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}).
It leads the group on interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2025}}), FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@2025}}) and FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2025}}).
The EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2025}}).

Cash liquidity to revenue is the strongest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2025}}), while capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} and advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} sit in the middle of the group.
